DESCRIPTION OF THE EVENT (what happened, when, where, who, what was released)
Subject: leak at Lloydminster PS
Compliance,
Doing monthly walkaround at Lloyd PS today. About 18:40 I caught a slow drip from a 4-in bypass
valve on the mainline pump skid. Valve had blown packing. Station op shut the block valves and
knocked the leak down. Meter on the sump truck showed 3.0 m³ collected. Nothing left the fence.
Cleanup crew was still hosing down the pad when I left.
J. Chen
Pipeline Patrol Contractor
SUPERVISOR REVIEW
